finalists.label: Histoplasmosis
finalists.why: It has specific evidence of intracellular yeasts with a surrounding halo and highlighted fungal forms.

finalists.label: Fungal infection
finalists.why: It has broad evidence of a dense diffuse infiltrate and fungal forms, although it is less specific than Histoplasmosis.

finalists.label: Chronic granulomatous disease
finalists.why: It explains the dense diffuse infiltrate and presence of intracellular yeasts, but lacks specificity compared to Histoplasmosis.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of intracellular yeasts with a surrounding halo specifically supports Histoplasmosis over the more general Fungal infection.

support_spans: Many histiocytes and giant cells contained intracellular yeasts with a surrounding halo
Special stains (Grocott-Gomori methenamine-silver nitrate and periodic acid–Schiff) highlighted fungal forms
contradict_spans: Fungal culture on Sabouraud dextrose agar was negative

support_spans: Single well-defined ulcer measuring 2 × 2 cm on the right lateral aspect of tongue with a clean base and irregular and elevated heaped-up margins
contradict_spans: No underlying induration, friability, or bleeding on manipulation
No history of trauma or tongue bite preceding the lesion
Patient denied consuming tobacco or alcohol regularly

contradict_spans: No history of high-risk behavior for HIV
